## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is from a branch or fork, not a direct push to `main`
- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (for example `fix: clamp prizes to 0..6`)
- [ ] `npm test` passes (and `npm run test:ui` if you changed the control panel, settings or overlay)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for new behavior
- [ ] I updated the docs and `CHANGELOG.md` if behavior changed
- [ ] If I changed dependencies: `npm audit` is clean
- [ ] There are no secrets, passwords or personal data in the diff
